Method of Attack: Dependency confusion attack by publishing higher version packages with same names as internal private packages to induce users to download malicious packages
Preventive packages published by Yandex to mitigate dependency confusion attacks
Discoverer: 奇安信技术研究院“天问“软件供应链安全分析平台
Impacted Systems: PyPI users relying on Yandex internal private packages
Attack Vector: Publishing packages with same names but higher versions on public PyPI to confuse dependency resolution
Multiple mirror sources usage leading to priority download of higher version packages from public source
Indicators of Compromise: 大量异常包上传事件于2023年1月27日至2月2日
